meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 当你在HyperFrames项目中需要制作动画时，Claude会帮你生成安全的2D/3D关键帧、GSAP时间线、CSS动画等，并自动验证它们是否可跳转、不出错。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude为HyperFrames项目编写或调试关键帧动画（如GSAP、CSS、SVG变形等）时触发。

say.text: 为这个SVG圆形添加一个从左上到右下的路径动画。
检查这段GSAP时间线是否可寻址安全。
给这个文字做淡入和水平移动效果。

howto.what_en: When you create animations in a HyperFrames project, Claude generates seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, etc., and verifies they are seek-safe and error-free.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to write or debug keyframe animations (GSAP, CSS, SVG morph, etc.) for a HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Add a path animation for this SVG circle from top-left to bottom-right.
Check if this GSAP timeline is seek-safe.
Fade in and move this text horizontally.
